content.figure_encoding: Panel A displays every supplied condition value and reported mean with a fixed -4 to 1 diverging color scale; Panel B shows SSA minus the strongest non-oracle comparator for each corruption. The oracle is distinguished with a gold outline.

key_results.oracle_qualification: Uses target labels and is not a same-information competitor.

content.reproducibility_note: run_generate.py locates the staged public inputs and executes generate_evidence.py; provenance.json records transformations and derived checks.
content.scientific_scope: Values are three-decimal, author-reported aggregates for 13 severity-5 UTKFace corruptions. Negative R2 values are retained. No repetitions, uncertainty estimates, significance claims, new experiments, or causal claims were fabricated.
content.summary: Prepared a compact evidence package containing complete tables, a rendered PNG figure, editable SVG source, caption and results text, generation code, a 98-cell linked ledger, and provenance metadata.

omissions: The available judging transport did not provide a rendered-image inspection tool, so the PNG was generated successfully but not visually inspected; visual acceptance therefore remains incomplete.
